title: Scalar transport of the etale/pro-etale adjunction unit
statement: For a unital finite-coefficient ring map φ:A→B and scheme T, ordinary scalar extension of the comparison-adjunction unit at the ordinary coefficient unit, followed by originReductionMap and the origin image of finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso, equals the ordinary scalar-unit isomorphism followed by the B comparison-adjunction unit.

proof.text: The single-functor unit isomorphism is the identity, so finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso is the site/scalar comparison followed by the comparison image of the ordinary scalar-unit isomorphism. Expand originReductionMap as the adjoint transpose of the inverse site/scalar comparison and scalar image of the counit. Naturality of the adjunction unit and the triangle identity identify its composite with scalar extension of the A unit. Cancel the site/scalar comparison with its inverse, then apply unit naturality to the ordinary scalar-unit isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2); explicit Lean construction and square pasting

lean.statement:
theorem scalarUnit_origin
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (Etale.scalarExtension φ T).map
        ((derivedComparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).unit.app
          (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit A T)) ≫
      Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.originReductionMap φ T (finiteGeneralRingUnit A T) ≫
      (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.origin B T).map (finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso φ T).hom =
    (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ T).hom ≫
      (derivedComparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) T).unit.app
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit B T)
